rows.name: amount
rows.doc: Master dial of the layer. 0 = the surface is exactly as it was before the layer. 1 = normal. 2 = double.

rows.name: seed
rows.doc: Moves where things fall; the same seed gives the same picture every time. (The kit also gives every object its own seed.)

rows.name: inflate_limit
rows.doc: A mark may be drawn at most this many times wider than real so that it stays visible at distance; beyond that it fades into an average tone.

rows.name: fade_start
rows.doc: Metres from the camera where fine detail starts to give way to the average tone.

rows.name: fade_end
rows.doc: Metres from the camera where fine detail has fully given way to the average tone (never to "clean").

rows.name: wet_follow
rows.doc: How much the layer follows the Wet Mask where a wetness layer exists (darker and glossier when wet). 0 = ignores wetness.

rows.name: film_mult
rows.doc: Colour multiplier of the general film on the clean surface (brick 0.50 to 0.65 in 1926).

rows.name: sheltered_mult
rows.doc: Multiplier where rain cannot reach (under sills, eaves, in reveals).

rows.name: washed_mult
rows.doc: Multiplier where rain washes (sill tops, the windward upper wall).

rows.name: washed_share
rows.doc: Share of wall area that is rain-washed (15 to 25 % in 1926).

rows.name: floor_mult
rows.doc: No dot may go below this multiple of its clean colour (keeps the film curve from crushing it).

rows.name: grey_pull
rows.doc: How far colour is pulled toward grey (25 to 35 % in 1926).

rows.name: mortar_soot
rows.doc: Extra darkening in mortar hollows (soot sits in hollows first).

rows.name: mottle_size
rows.doc: Size of the slow mottling.

rows.name: mottle_contrast
rows.doc: How strong the mottling is.

rows.name: edge_sharp
rows.doc: How crisp the line is between washed and sheltered (a clean line under a sill).

rows.name: stack_mult
rows.doc: Multiplier on chimney stacks (blackest in a coal town).

rows.name: roof_mult
rows.doc: Multiplier on roof surfaces.

rows.name: base_lift
rows.doc: LAST-RESORT dial: lifts the whole wall colour so that a pattern has room above the film-black zone. Off unless the integrator proves it is needed and says so.

rows.name: mottle_stretch
rows.doc: How much taller than wide the soot mottling is (soot clouds run in columns: 1.8 to 2.5).

rows.name: patch_min_dots
rows.doc: Smallest soot or washed patch, in plate dots (patches of 15 dots or more survive the painter).

rows.name: rough_gain
rows.doc: How much duller (rougher) the sooted surface becomes; soot is a dry crust.

rows.name: shade_wash
rows.doc: How much shade keeps the rain-washed patches away (0 = shade makes no difference, 1 = none in full shade).

rows.name: washed_pale
rows.doc: Pale-first: how much the washed patches are lifted above the surrounding film, so that they read on a dark wall (0 = only the washed_mult value).

rows.name: edge_dark

rows.name: width_dots
rows.doc: Smallest streak width in plate dots (the layer widens a streak with distance up to Inflate Limit).

rows.name: length_mult
rows.doc: Length of every streak.

rows.name: ragged
rows.doc: Ragged sides and a stretched-down shape.

rows.name: source_share
rows.doc: Share of sills, ledges and cap edges that carry a streak pair (60 to 80 % in 1926).

rows.name: leak_share
rows.doc: Share of downpipes that leak heavily and carry a long streak.

rows.name: leak_length
rows.doc: Length of a heavy leak streak.

rows.name: iron_rust
rows.doc: How orange (rust) a streak is when its source is an iron joint or bracket.

rows.name: eave_streaks
rows.doc: Streaks hanging from eave lines, gutter ends and cap overhangs.

rows.name: pitch_mult
rows.doc: Spacing of the streaks inside a run-off zone (1 = a streak about every 0.25 m).

rows.name: pair_share
rows.doc: How strongly the two edges of every ledge (the sill ends) carry a streak of their own.

rows.name: stain_value
rows.doc: How much brighter than its surround a pale stripe is made, 1 = the strongest allowed (pale-first on dark walls).

rows.doc: Darkening of the film (at most about one third).

rows.name: polish

rows.name: polish_lift

rows.name: polish_rough

rows.name: water_marks

rows.name: rust_halo

rows.name: drum_ring

rows.name: tar_patches

rows.name: tar_max_share
rows.doc: Ceiling on tar patches as a share of road area (2 to 4 %).

rows.name: tar_splash
rows.doc: Splashes of tar at the kerb foot.

rows.name: tar_gloss
rows.doc: How glossy new tar is (near black when wet).

rows.name: scrub_strip

rows.name: scrub_strip_m
rows.doc: Reach of the scrubbed strip.

rows.name: show_part
rows.doc: Checking view only: 0 = the whole Mask output; 1 film, 2 polish, 3 water marks, 4 rust halo, 5 drum ring, 6 tar patches, 7 tar splash, 8 scrub strip.

rows.name: film_octaves
rows.doc: How broken-up the film patches are (noise detail).

rows.name: dust
rows.doc: A thin even dust on all ground that dulls its tone a little at every distance (the film is patchy and gives way to its average far away; this is the part that stays).

rows.name: ring_m
rows.doc: Width of the dried puddle ring.

rows.name: pool_scale_m
rows.doc: Size of the shallow dips the dried puddle rings sit in.

rows.name: drum_ring_m
rows.doc: Width of the rust bleed ring round the fire drum.

rows.name: tar_spacing_m
rows.doc: Tar patch sites lie on a loose grid of this size.

rows.name: tar_patch_m
rows.doc: Longest half-size of a tar patch (shrunk so that tar_max_share is never passed).

rows.name: tar_weathered
rows.doc: Share of tar patches that are old, grey and matt (the rest are new, black and glossy).

rows.name: tar_chippings
rows.doc: Strength of the pale chippings speckle on a tar patch.

rows.name: splash_m
rows.doc: Size of a tar splash at the kerb foot.

rows.name: scrub_whitened_share
rows.doc: Same number as the doorstep layer's whitened_share (copied from the look when the layer is registered).

rows.name: scrub_scrubbed_share
rows.doc: Same number as the doorstep layer's scrubbed_share (copied from the look when the layer is registered).

rows.name: scrub_lift
rows.doc: How much paler the scrubbed strip on the flags is than the dirty flags round it.

rows.name: mark_dots
rows.doc: Smallest width in plate dots of a stain edge or a ring (they are widened with distance up to Inflate Limit).

rows.name: far_band_m
rows.doc: Width of the far band.

rows.name: moss_value
rows.doc: Plate brightness of dry moss (lighter than the stone; painted values under 0.12 are black on the film).

rows.name: show_part
rows.doc: Checking view only: 0 = whole Mask; 1 joint moss, 2 patch moss, 3 algae fans, 4 liverwort, 5 far band, 6 all joints where moss could grow (the length the moss share is counted against).

rows.name: patch_moss
rows.doc: Moss as soft patches on open ground (for sets with no joints, e.g. earth, gravel, stones). A set that wants moss only in joints gives the role a multiplier of 0.

rows.name: patch_scale_m
rows.doc: Size of a moss patch on open ground.

rows.name: moss_lift
rows.doc: How much lighter than the stone beneath the dry moss is (in scene light; the painter weakens colour, so moss is made stronger than wanted).

rows.name: moss_rim
rows.doc: A paler rim on the moss edge (a painted look).

rows.name: liverwort_m
rows.doc: Size of a liverwort patch.

rows.name: algae_dark
rows.doc: How dark the algae film is (1 = near black-green).

rows.name: outlet_reach
rows.doc: How close to a wall (0 touching, 1 = the set's wall reach) a standing foot must be to count as a downpipe outlet; posts stand farther out.

meta.roles: iron, iron.post, iron.pipe, fire (cast iron, steel, drum, rails)
meta.masks: height, object zmin and zmax, drip_kind, vertical_foot

rows.name: amount
rows.doc: Master dial of the layer. 0 = the surface is exactly as it was before the layer. 1 = normal. 2 = double.

rows.name: seed
rows.doc: Moves where things fall; the same seed gives the same picture every time. (The kit also gives every object its own seed.)

rows.name: inflate_limit
rows.doc: A mark may be drawn at most this many times wider than real so that it stays visible at distance; beyond that it fades into an average tone.

rows.name: fade_start
rows.doc: Metres from the camera where fine detail starts to give way to the average tone.

rows.name: fade_end
rows.doc: Metres from the camera where fine detail has fully given way to the average tone (never to "clean").

rows.name: wet_follow
rows.doc: How much the layer follows the Wet Mask where a wetness layer exists (darker and glossier when wet). 0 = ignores wetness.

rows.name: rust_cover
rows.doc: Share of the lower part of an iron object with paint chipped back to rust.

rows.name: rust_height
rows.doc: How high rust reaches from the foot of a post.

rows.name: chip_share
rows.doc: Share of paint chipped in the rust zone.

rows.name: collar_spacing
rows.doc: Spacing of pipe collars and joints where rust rings sit.

rows.name: collar_rust
rows.doc: Share of collars with rust.

rows.name: metallic_drop
rows.doc: Rust lowers Metallic by up to this fraction (cast iron 0.6, steel 0.5, brass 0.9).

rows.name: heat_scale
rows.doc: Heat-blued scale on the fire drum only.

rows.name: soot_halo
rows.doc: Sooty halo above the drum vent holes and black rim.

rows.name: paint_keep
rows.doc: Share of the original paint kept (black or dark green).

rows.name: rust_run
rows.doc: Length of rust runs below fixings.

rows.name: show_part
rows.doc: Checking view only: 0 = whole Mask; 1 foot rust, 2 collar rings, 3 shoe streak, 4 base ring, 5 drum rust, 6 heat scale, 7 soot.

rows.name: streak_m
rows.doc: Width of a vertical rust or wet streak.

rows.name: rust_bright
rows.doc: Brightness of rust against the iron paint it lies on (1 = as dark as the paint).

rows.name: grime_dark
rows.doc: A thin even coat of soot on all iron: it darkens the paint a little at every distance.

rows.name: shoe_streak
rows.doc: Dark wet streak at the foot (shoe) of a downpipe.

rows.name: shoe_height
rows.doc: How high the dark wet streak at the pipe shoe reaches.

rows.name: base_ring
rows.doc: Rust ring at the base flange of a post.

rows.name: base_ring_m
rows.doc: Height of the base-flange ring.

rows.name: collar_m
rows.doc: Height of a rust ring at a collar.

rows.name: drum_rust
rows.doc: Share of a drum covered by rust and old paint (60 to 80 percent).

rows.name: rim_soot_m
rows.doc: Height of the black soot rim at the top of a drum.

meta.roles: ground.sett, ground.flag, ground.channel, ground.kerb (scatter targets; others by settings)
meta.masks: weed_site, moss_site, keepclear, footfall, rubbish_heap, wall_dist, seam_dist, shade, dampness, existing_growth

rows.name: amount
rows.doc: Master dial of the layer. 0 = the surface is exactly as it was before the layer. 1 = normal. 2 = double.

rows.name: seed
rows.doc: Moves where things fall; the same seed gives the same picture every time. (The kit also gives every object its own seed.)

rows.name: inflate_limit
rows.doc: A mark may be drawn at most this many times wider than real so that it stays visible at distance; beyond that it fades into an average tone.

rows.name: fade_start
rows.doc: Metres from the camera where fine detail starts to give way to the average tone.

rows.name: fade_end
rows.doc: Metres from the camera where fine detail has fully given way to the average tone (never to "clean").

rows.name: wet_follow
rows.doc: How much the layer follows the Wet Mask where a wetness layer exists (darker and glossier when wet). 0 = ignores wetness.

rows.name: weeds_amount
rows.doc: Amount of weed pieces (grass tufts, rosettes). 0 = none.

rows.name: cushions_amount
rows.doc: Amount of moss cushion pieces. 0 = none.

rows.name: distance
rows.doc: Pieces are laid only up to this far from the camera (the camera of the picture being drawn).

rows.name: distance_fade
rows.doc: Length of the fade-out at the pieces distance.

rows.name: piece_size
rows.doc: Size of every piece (1 = as built to the period sizes).

rows.name: weed_cover
rows.doc: Green cover of weeds as a share of ground area inside the pieces distance (0.5 to 2 % in 1926).

rows.name: gutter_tuft_share
rows.doc: Share of gutter-side joint length with a visible tuft (3 to 8 %).

rows.name: wall_foot_share
rows.doc: Share of wall-foot length with a plant (2 to 5 %).

rows.name: cushion_cover
rows.doc: Moss cushion cover as a share of ground area inside the pieces distance.

rows.name: min_spacing
rows.doc: Nearest two pieces of one kind may be.

rows.name: toadflax_clumps
rows.doc: Ivy-leaved toadflax trails on damp mortar: 0 to 2 clumps in the whole street.

rows.name: rubbish_thin_max
rows.doc: Weeds grow at full density through rubbish thinner than this mask value.

rows.name: rubbish_heap_min
rows.doc: No weeds (and no moss above 0.6) on rubbish heavier than this mask value; between the two it thins out linearly.

rows.name: dead_grass_share
rows.doc: Share of grass tufts that are dead and straw-coloured.

rows.name: flower_share
rows.doc: Share of dandelions in flower or seed-clock (a few only).

rows.name: max_pieces
rows.doc: Hard ceiling on pieces in one picture (drawing time).

rows.name: wet_dark
rows.doc: Colour multiple of wet pieces (richer green, darker).

rows.name: tilt_random
rows.doc: How much each piece leans.

rows.name: piece_inflate_limit
rows.doc: How many times bigger than real a plant may be drawn so that it stays at least min_dots plate dots wide at a distance (the growth layer's own, lower limit).

rows.name: moss_smother_from
rows.doc: Rubbish value above which moss cushions start to thin out.

rows.name: moss_smother_to
rows.doc: Rubbish value at which moss cushions have stopped.

rows.name: existing_avoid
rows.doc: How much the places that already have growth (the set's existing_growth) are left alone: 0 grow on it, 1 none on it.

rows.name: avoid_m
rows.doc: Nearest a plant may stand to a 3D piece of the objects named in growth.avoid_pieces_of (litter).

rows.name: colour_gain
rows.doc: Multiplies the colour of every piece (tuning the plate brightness).

rows.name: min_dots_scale
rows.doc: Multiplies every kind's smallest width in plate dots (species.json min_dots: 6 for weeds, 5 for moss) that a plant is widened to at a distance (never past piece_inflate_limit).

rows.name: colour_sat
rows.doc: Multiplies the colour saturation of every piece (1 = species.json as written).

rows.name: show_kind
rows.doc: Checking view only: -1 all kinds, otherwise only the kind with that number.

rows.name: realise
rows.doc: Turn the instances into plain meshes (1) or keep instances (0).

rows.name: cand_density_scale
rows.doc: Multiplier of the candidate points of every kind (finer choice of places, slower).
